content.title: Arion Kurtaj Pleads Guilty to Cybercrime Charges
content.caption: Arion Kurtaj, a 21-year-old member of the Lapsus$ cybercrime group, pleaded guilty to hacking and leaking 90 videos of Grand Theft Auto VI in 2022.

slides.heading: Arion Kurtaj Pleads Guilty to Cybercrime Charges
slides.text: Arion Kurtaj, a 21-year-old member of the Lapsus$ cybercrime group, pleaded guilty to hacking and leaking 90 videos of Grand Theft Auto VI in 2022.

slides.heading: Leaked 90 Videos of GTA VI
slides.text: Arion Kurtaj leaked 90 videos of Grand Theft Auto VI years before its release, which led to a marked increase in unauthorised SIM swaps of BT/EE customers' mobile phones.

slides.heading: Hacked Other Big Companies
slides.text: Arion Kurtaj hacked other big companies such as Rockstar Games, Uber, and Revolut, using a mobile phone, hotel TV's Wi-Fi, and a firestick.
